about: A fast desktop app for looking at and exporting data from your databases.

prs.title: Database exports keep mixed-case table names
prs.broken: Exporting a Postgres database with mixed-case table names, the default for Prisma, stopped with an error and left a half-written file.
prs.changed: Names with capital letters are now quoted in the export, and each export uses the right SQL style for its database.
prs.matters: Exports from Prisma and similar projects finish and restore with the same table names.
